external_context.paper: Jonsson, Lagerkvist, Osipov, CSPs with Few Alien Constraints, CP 2024
external_context.relevant_result: For Boolean Schaefer base language A, CSP with finitely parameterized alien constraints from B is FPT in the number of alien constraints.

scope.L: original encoded input length proxy carried explicitly by the frozen instance contract
scope.k: number of alien constraints in the chosen orientation

formal_theorem_target.statement: For a fixed base relation language with an exact polynomial native solver closed under variable pinning, and a fixed alien relation R with q satisfying tuples, an instance with k alien constraints is exactly solvable by enumerating the q^k alien tuple selections, rejecting inconsistent overlaps, pinning the induced variable values into the base instance, and invoking the native base solver. If q^k <= L, the complete lifecycle is polynomial in L.
formal_theorem_target.exactness: F = Base AND R_1 AND ... AND R_k is satisfiable iff there exists one satisfying tuple t_i of every R_i such that overlapping tuple choices are consistent and the pinned Base instance is satisfiable.
formal_theorem_target.sat_reconstruction: A consistent alien tuple selection plus the exact native base witness gives a full original witness; original relations are replayed independently.
formal_theorem_target.unsat_rule: UNSAT may be returned only after every one of the q^k tuple selections is either overlap-inconsistent or has an independently replayable native-base UNSAT result.
formal_theorem_target.complexity: At most q^k <= L branches. Each branch performs polynomial overlap consistency, base-instance pinning, native solve, reconstruction/replay. Therefore T_total <= L * poly(L) and serialized branch receipts <= L * poly(L).

mandatory_gates.G1_CANONICAL_ALIEN_ORDER: Alien constraints and their satisfying tuples use deterministic frozen ordering; no result-dependent ordering changes admission or semantics.
mandatory_gates.G2_COMPLETE_TUPLE_ENUMERATION: For admitted instances, every satisfying tuple of every alien relation participates in the exact Cartesian product over alien constraints; no tuple is pruned except by explicit overlap inconsistency.
mandatory_gates.G3_NO_GLOBAL_VARIABLE_CUBE: Candidate may enumerate alien tuple choices only; it may not enumerate all assignments to all instance variables or to a larger interface cube.
mandatory_gates.G4_OVERLAP_CONSISTENCY: Shared variables among alien constraints must carry identical values in a surviving tuple selection.
mandatory_gates.G5_NATIVE_PINNED_SOLVER: After alien tuple selection, only the sealed native base carrier plus explicit variable pins may be used.
mandatory_gates.G6_ORIGINAL_REPLAY: SAT witness must replay every original base and alien constraint.
mandatory_gates.G7_COMPLETE_UNSAT_ACCOUNTING: Every admitted tuple-selection branch must have a deterministic rejection reason or native exact UNSAT result before global UNSAT.
mandatory_gates.G8_POLYNOMIAL_ADMISSION: Reject OPEN_ALIEN_TUPLE_BUDGET when q^k > L; no exponential fallback is allowed.
mandatory_gates.G9_CONNECTED_CONTROL: At least one positive control must have a connected variable-constraint incidence graph with multiple cycles, proving the scope is not merely disconnected factorization or a tree gate.
mandatory_gates.G10_REGRESSION: Schaefer mixed-carrier barrier, factorized-feedback portfolio, and affine quotient regressions remain green.

controls.P1_CONNECTED_OR2_BASE_XOR_ALIENS_SAT: Connected cyclic OR2 backbone with overlapping EVEN_XOR3 alien constraints, admitted by 4^k <= L, exact SAT witness replay.
controls.P2_CONNECTED_OR2_BASE_XOR_ALIENS_UNSAT: Admitted connected instance where every alien tuple selection is overlap-inconsistent or makes pinned OR2 base unsatisfiable; require complete branch accounting.
controls.P3_CONNECTED_AFFINE_BASE_OR2_ALIENS: Reverse orientation using affine native base and OR2 aliens under 3^k <= L.
controls.N1_OVER_BUDGET: Instance with q^k > L must return OPEN_ALIEN_TUPLE_BUDGET before tuple-product solving.
controls.N2_OVERLAP_CONFLICT: Two alien tuple selections disagreeing on a shared variable are rejected before native solve.
controls.N3_REPLAY_TAMPER: Tampered SAT witness must be rejected by original-relation replay.
controls.N4_NO_GLOBAL_ENUMERATOR: Static/source audit rejects global full-variable assignment enumeration.

next_step_after_freeze: Implement minimal exact tuple-selection router with native OR2 and affine solvers, an independently written checker, and a GitHub Actions gate.
